meta.name: add-slack
meta.description: Add Slack channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 将 Slack 频道集成到你的应用中
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在应用里发送或接收 Slack 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Slack channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to send or receive Slack messages in your app.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能通过 Chat SDK 连接 Slack：复制并注册 Slack 适配器、安装固定版本依赖、构建测试、收集凭证、解析私聊频道，随后可在频道和私聊中收发消息，并用 Slack 的 mrkdwn 语法格式化消息。
howto.when: 当用户要求添加 Slack 集成，或提到 Slack 关键词，或在 /setup 流程中选择接入 Slack 时触发。

say.note: 开始执行 add-slack 技能，复制并注册适配器。

say.text: 用 Socket Mode 接入 Slack
say.note: 会要求提供 Bot Token 和 App Token。

say.text: 配置 Slack 用 Webhook 接收消息
say.note: 会要求公网 URL 和签名密钥。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude can connect to Slack via Chat SDK: it copies/registers the adapter, installs the pinned dependency, collects credentials, resolves DMs, then sends/receives messages in channels and DMs using Slack mrkdwn.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add Slack integration, mentions Slack, or chooses Slack during /setup.

say_en.text: Set up Slack with Socket Mode.
say_en.note: Prompts for Bot Token and App Token.

say_en.text: Configure Slack to receive via webhook.
say_en.note: Requires a public URL and signing secret.
